verdicts.reason: A: the 'Pick Your Flavour' CTA is shrunk to an unreadable pill stuck in the bottom-left corner, cut off from everything else. The flavour list is out of the original order, its items shrink step by step and the dots form a ragged diagonal, and there is dead space under the copy. B has the same reordered, shrinking, ragged list and a can that dominates the frame, but its CTA is readable and sits just under the list, so the reading order of brand, headline, list then action survives.
